subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to replace the underlined segment in the given sentence. **

They __spoke__ about the political turmoil in the state.
solution:
The correct answer is **'talked'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Spoke **means to have said something in order to convey information.

 
 
• Example- The PM **spoke** to the flood victims.
 
 
 
• **Talked** means communication by spoken words; conversation or discussion.
 
 
• Example- Two men **talked** in the bar.
 
 
 
• The given sentence implies that the persons were discussing the political turmoil in the state.
 
• Hence, this is the most appropriate option to substitute underlined word.

**Correct Sentence:__** *They __**talked**__ about the political turmoil in the state.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Expressed** means conveying a thought or feeling in words or gestures. 

 
 
• Example- He **expressed **his satisfaction.
 
 
 
• **Stated** means clearly expressed or specified.
 
 
• Example- The notice **stated** the aim of the meeting.
